definitions.gloss: coastal waters; nearby seas; home waters
definitions.explanation: The seas near a country's coast, as against the open ocean. Common in fishing and weather reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{近海|きんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an earthquake in the seas near Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{近海|きんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{獲|と}れた⟦マグロ→マグロ：11134_maguro⟧だ。
examples.english: This tuna was caught in nearby waters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧{近海|きんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧し、⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: A typhoon formed in the waters near Okinawa and is moving north.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{近海|きんかい}: the seas around Japan
- {近海|きんかい}もの: fish caught in local waters (prized at sushi shops: {近海|きんかい}⟦マグロ→マグロ：11134_maguro⟧)
- {近海|きんかい}⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧: inshore fishing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遠洋|えんよう}→遠洋：31282_enyou⟧: the open ocean, far seas (⟦{遠洋|えんよう}→遠洋：31282_enyou⟧⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧, deep-sea fishing) — the opposite
- ⟦{沖|おき}→沖：02144_oki⟧: offshore, out at sea, seen from the shore
